calculation.description: Fades the completed session intraday return after normalizing by its trailing 20-session intraday-return volatility. Higher values indicate stronger risk-adjusted reversal potential. The signal uses only data available through the completed session.

validation.regime_notes: Daily Spearman IC remained positive across 2020-2022 (+0.06476), 2023-2024 (+0.04873), and 2025-2026 (+0.04638). Effective cross-section averaged 11.65 instruments; uncertainty is interpreted conservatively for the 15-asset universe.
